_note: Same app as layla.json in every respect except grade. Identical palette, crest, name and voice. Grade 1 forces tap-the-answer instead of typed working, because a six-year-old has no algebraic notation — that is a consequence of the grade, not a separate design choice.
name: Smart Cheer Math
tagline: Math, but make it a cheer competition. Pick your level, superstar. 🦅
howToPlay: Read the story. Then tap the answer you think is right. Get it wrong and we'll help you try again. Stuck? Tap Need a tip? 📣
levelPickerSubtitle: Level 1 = comfy couch. Level 5 = final boss. 🔥
footerNote: ✨ No sign-up, no passwords — just you, some numbers, and glory. 💙

levels.name: Pom-Pom Counting
levels.tagline: Add them up. Easy peasy pom-pom squeezy.
levels.cheer: You packed 3 pom-poms in your cheer bag. Coach hands you 2 more. 📣
levels.question: How many pom-poms now?
hints: Hold up 3 fingers. Now put up 2 more.

levels.name: Spirit Ribbons
levels.cheer: The squad sold 6 spirit ribbons before lunch. After lunch they sold 3 more. 🎀
levels.question: How many ribbons did they sell?

levels.name: Snack Break
levels.cheer: There were 8 orange slices for the squad. The flyers ate 3 of them. 🍊
levels.question: How many orange slices are left?

levels.name: The Missing Cheerleader
levels.tagline: Somebody is missing. Can you work out how many?
levels.cheer: You need 7 cheerleaders for the pyramid. Only 4 have showed up so far. 📣
levels.question: How many more do you need?
hints: Start at 4. How many steps to get to 7?

levels.name: Balloons for the Big Game
levels.tagline: All the way up to twenty! 🏆
levels.cheer: You tied up 9 red balloons and 7 blue balloons for the big game. 🎈
levels.question: How many balloons altogether?
hints: Make a ten first. Take 1 from the 7 and give it to the 9.
Now you have 10, and 6 left over.

_themeNote: Lavender. Gold accent, because a second lavender would have nothing to push against.

verses.text: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
Let us not be weary in doing good…
